title: Mapping a protocol's output commutes with execution
statement: Let $g : \alpha \to \beta$ be a function between output types, let $p$ be a finite-message protocol with outputs in $\alpha$, and let $x \in X$ and $y \in Y$ be inputs. Then \[ \mathrm{run}\bigl(\mathrm{map}(g, p),\, x,\, y\bigr) = g\bigl(\mathrm{run}(p, x, y)\bigr). \]
hypotheses_covered: a function g : α → β between output types
a finite-message protocol p with outputs in α
replaced:
For any function $g : \alpha \to \beta$, protocol $p$, and inputs $x \in X$, $y \in Y$,
\[
  (\texttt{map}\;g\;p).\texttt{run}\;x\;y \;=\; g\,(p.\texttt{run}\;x\;y).
\]
